pipelines.inventory_signature: dcl_texcoord t0.xy; dcl_2d s0; texld oC0,t0,s0
pipelines.accepted_original: The measured three-instruction ps_3_0 copy: seven base-archive chunks (four shaders001, three imagespace002), 184/188 bytes, CTAB Image, HeightMap or BaseSampler. Exact registers, masks, swizzles and sampler type are checked structurally.
pipelines.package_rule: Observed in shadersfx\shaders001.fxp and shadersfx\imagespace002.fxp; path is provenance, not an acceptance key.
pipelines.vertex_inputs: Clip-space position plus texcoord0. No vertex colour is required.
pipelines.texture_units: Unit 0: sampler s0, 2D LDR source image.
pipelines.quality_reductions: RGBA8 TEV output; no HDR, colour transform, filtering change or gamma conversion is implied.
pipelines.unsupported: Non-identity swizzles, extra instructions, cube/volume samplers, MRT, depth output, undefined alpha requiring an extra stage, and any lighting/fog work.
pipelines.fallback: Reject with a named structural mismatch. Do not silently turn an unknown post-process shader into a copy.
pipelines.memory: One resident source texture, one TEV stage and one draw. No original bytecode or CTAB needs to remain resident after the plan is built.

pipelines.inventory_signature: Straight-line unlit ps_3_0 utility subset: nop/mov/add/sub/mad/mul/dp3/lrp/texld/dcl/def; 2D samplers; <=3 textures; <=6 TEV stages.
pipelines.accepted_original: The generic TEV translator's unlit subset, additionally restricted to texcoord/colour PS inputs and no lighting, water, sky, terrain, character or shadow CTAB vocabulary. It covers cross-family copy/tint/flare utility chunks only when the caller explicitly routes them as interface work.
pipelines.package_rule: Any package; CTAB and instruction features decide acceptance.
pipelines.vertex_inputs: Clip-space position, at most three PS colour/texcoord vectors; texcoord registers used by texld.
pipelines.texture_units: 0-3 declared 2D samplers; only samplers actually sampled consume units.
pipelines.quality_reductions: LDR only; RGBA8 stage constants/outputs; identity or replicated RGB swizzles; negate is the only source modifier; undefined output alpha costs one fixup stage.
pipelines.unsupported: Branching/loops, rcp/rsq/nrm/cmp/dp4, texkill, non-uniform swizzles, cube/volume samplers, >3 live PS input vectors, >3 textures, >6 stages, MRT and depth output.
pipelines.fallback: Reject by opcode/dataflow reason. ui.copy remains available only for its exact structural signature; text must use ui.scaleform.glyph.
pipelines.memory: At most three resident textures and six stage descriptors per plan; at most eight external constant registers. Batch by compatible blend/depth state.

passes.name: unlit
passes.vertex_inputs: position plus declared texcoord/colour PS inputs
passes.summary: One translated straight-line pass; actual stage/texture counts come from structural translation.

pipelines.inventory_signature: Engine-fixed Scaleform glyph quad: clip position + texcoord0 + colour0, straight-alpha glyph atlas.
pipelines.accepted_original: No .fxp signature exists for Scaleform text. Acceptance is an explicit material-kind/precondition contract, never a shader hash: source=fixed_scaleform, material=scaleform_glyph_atlas, no SM3 bytecode.
pipelines.package_rule: Interface.bsa / Scaleform runtime path; outside the .fxp inventory.
pipelines.vertex_inputs: Clip-space position, texcoord0 and colour0 (text tint, including alpha).
pipelines.texture_units: Unit 0: one pre-rasterised straight-alpha LDR glyph atlas.
pipelines.quality_reductions: Single atlas fetch, bilinear filtering, vertex tint. No SDF outline, subpixel coverage, colour glyphs, HDR or custom Scaleform pixel program.
pipelines.unsupported: SDF/outline/shadow glyph variants, colour-font layers, dynamic glyph atlases without residency, and unvalidated premultiplied alpha.
pipelines.fallback: Reject unsupported glyph variants. A missing atlas is an asset error; do not substitute an unrelated menu texture.
pipelines.memory: One atlas texture plus caller-owned quad vertices. Keep atlas pages resident while their glyph batch is alive; no CTAB or SM3 program retention.

pipelines.inventory_signature: PS CTAB PParams/ColorRange/SunColor/SunDir/SunDisc/Atmosphere; measured 1-2 samples, no branches, 7 distinct streams.
pipelines.accepted_original: Planned acceptance requires the sky vocabulary, ps_3_0, <=2 2D samples, no branches and a dedicated sky draw route. The two frc programs and six multi-temp programs are not accepted by the current generic translator.
pipelines.package_rule: Sky-classified chunks in shaders001; path alone is insufficient.
pipelines.vertex_inputs: Clip position, view direction (or texcoord carrying it), optional sun/moon parameters from constants.
pipelines.texture_units: Optional sky gradient/cloud texture; at most two original samples, one resident unit after baking.
pipelines.quality_reductions: Analytic LDR gradient and sun disc; optional pre-baked cloud texture; drop procedural frc noise and multi-temp atmospheric scattering.
pipelines.unsupported: HDR atmospheric scattering, dynamic weather interpolation requiring branches, cube/volume sampling and more than one cloud layer in the first version.
pipelines.fallback: Clear to the supplied fog/horizon colour and skip the sky draw; no world-material substitution.
pipelines.memory: One small LDR sky texture at most; no full-screen colour target. A separate cloud pass doubles fill cost but not texture residency beyond two units.

passes.name: sky.base
passes.summary: Gradient plus sun/moon disc; TEV plan not implemented yet.

passes.name: sky.clouds
passes.summary: Optional second pass; omit entirely at reduced quality.

pipelines.inventory_signature: MultiTextureDiffuse0..5Sampler / MultiTextureNormal0..5Sampler, optional LODNoiseSampler, HeightSampler and WorldMapOverlay*; 3-15 samples.
pipelines.accepted_original: Planned acceptance requires terrain CTAB vocabulary and explicit tiling metadata. No single PICA pass can consume the measured 13-15 sample chunks; acceptance is per layer group, not whole-program translation.
pipelines.package_rule: 11 terrain-classified packages; material layer table must name the package/meta permutation.
pipelines.vertex_inputs: Clip position, normal, texcoord0 and optional vertex colour; tangent basis only if normals are decoded in-shader.
pipelines.texture_units: Original: six diffuse plus six normal layers, LOD noise/height and optional map overlay. PICA: three resident 2D units per pass.
pipelines.quality_reductions: Pre-decode normals offline; near field uses six diffuse layers, far field uses 1-2 baked layers; drop parallax, world-map overlay and live LOD noise first.
pipelines.unsupported: Single-pass 12+ samples, HDR layer blending, arbitrary per-pixel layer counts and unconstrained dynamic samplers.
pipelines.fallback: Explicit far-field baked terrain texture or reject the tile. Never silently drop layers without the degraded-quality request.
pipelines.memory: Faithful path: 12 layer textures plus overlays cannot all be resident; stream three per pass. Three-pass predecoded path needs six diffuse textures and one overlay group. Baked far tiles add one texture but release the six near layers.

passes.name: terrain.layers0_2
passes.summary: First three layers; plan not implemented.

passes.name: terrain.lod_overlay
passes.texture_units: LOD noise, height, optional world-map overlay
passes.summary: Optional overlays; without offline normal decode the faithful layer path needs four layer passes plus this pass.

pipelines.inventory_signature: p5_MAD_NORMAL: 24 instructions, 840 bytes, def c8={2,-1,1,0}, normal.xyz=normal.xzyw*2-1.
pipelines.accepted_original: Five measured base-archive chunks in shadersfx\lighting\059\p5.fxp. Requires the exact structural menu-light signature plus the eight-constant base-lit vocabulary; package/hash are not acceptance keys. The fixed plan's final stage is RGB modulation by the c7.a fade; c7.rgb is ignored.
pipelines.package_rule: Observed metas 0x0005, 0x8085, 0x8105, 0x8185, 0x8205 in p5.fxp; all must still pass instruction/CTAB validation.
pipelines.vertex_inputs: Clip position, texcoord0, color0 and color1. Asset normal/tangent data is consumed by preprocessing, not by this PS signature.
pipelines.texture_units: Unit 0: s0 DiffuseSampler. Unit 1: s1 NormalSampler, pre-decoded/pre-swizzled for the TEV plan.
pipelines.quality_reductions: One directional light, LDR TEV, pre-baked tangent basis, ambient+emissive folded into color1, material alpha in c4.a, and a five-stage plan whose final stage multiplies RGB by the c7.a fade. c7.rgb is ignored and alpha passes through; retail dp4 basis transforms and xzyw decode are not emitted directly.
pipelines.unsupported: Shadow mask, point lights, envmap, specular, subsurface/backlight, projected noise, parallax, HDR, skinning and any opcode/register/literal change outside the structural signature.
pipelines.fallback: static.diffuse_fallback, but only after an explicit degraded-quality request and once that planned fallback is implemented; otherwise reject.
pipelines.memory: Two resident textures, three TEV constant vectors (c3/c4/c7; only c7.a is consumed), two colour varyings and five stages. Preprocessed normal texture matches diffuse dimensions; tangent basis is per-vertex asset data.

passes.name: static.base_lit
passes.summary: dot3 NdotL; light; diffuse*light and alpha; vertex tint/alpha; RGB *= c7.a fade with alpha passthrough (c7.rgb ignored).

pipelines.inventory_signature: p1200005_ADD_NORMAL: 25 instructions, 852 bytes, def c8={-0.5,1,0,0}, normal.xyz=(normal.xzyw-0.5)*2.
pipelines.accepted_original: One measured base-archive chunk in shadersfx\lighting\059\p1200005.fxp. Requires the exact structural menu-light signature plus the eight-constant base-lit vocabulary; package/hash are not acceptance keys. The fixed plan's final stage is RGB modulation by the c7.a fade; c7.rgb is ignored.
pipelines.package_rule: Observed meta 0x1200005 at offset 12 with a 78-byte reflection trailer; metadata remains provenance only.
pipelines.vertex_inputs: Clip position, texcoord0, color0 and color1. Asset normal/tangent data is consumed by preprocessing, not by this PS signature.
pipelines.texture_units: Unit 0: s0 DiffuseSampler. Unit 1: s1 NormalSampler, pre-decoded/pre-swizzled for the TEV plan.
pipelines.quality_reductions: One directional light, LDR TEV, pre-baked tangent basis, ambient+emissive folded into color1, material alpha in c4.a, and a five-stage plan whose final stage multiplies RGB by the c7.a fade. c7.rgb is ignored and alpha passes through; retail dp4 basis transforms and xzyw decode are not emitted directly.
pipelines.unsupported: Shadow mask, point lights, envmap, specular, subsurface/backlight, projected noise, parallax, HDR, skinning and any opcode/register/literal change outside the structural signature.
pipelines.fallback: static.diffuse_fallback, but only after an explicit degraded-quality request and once that planned fallback is implemented; otherwise reject.
pipelines.memory: Two resident textures, three TEV constant vectors (c3/c4/c7; only c7.a is consumed), two colour varyings and five stages. Preprocessed normal texture matches diffuse dimensions; tangent basis is per-vertex asset data.

passes.name: static.base_lit
passes.summary: dot3 NdotL; light; diffuse*light and alpha; vertex tint/alpha; RGB *= c7.a fade with alpha passthrough (c7.rgb ignored).

pipelines.inventory_signature: Explicit degraded material contract: diffuse texture, vertex colour and optional fog; no SM3 acceptance.
pipelines.accepted_original: Not implemented. Reserved for static meshes whose lighting permutation is unsupported and whose caller explicitly requests diffuse-only quality.
pipelines.package_rule: Material metadata only; never selected automatically by a failed shader match.
pipelines.vertex_inputs: Clip position, texcoord0, color0 and optional fog factor.
pipelines.quality_reductions: Drop normal mapping, directional/specular lighting, shadows and vertex secondary colour; retain alpha and fog.
pipelines.unsupported: Automatic fallback, skinned meshes, alpha-blended cutout geometry and HDR materials.
pipelines.fallback: Reject the draw if the caller did not explicitly request degraded quality or this plan is not implemented.
pipelines.memory: One texture and 1-2 TEV stages; lowest static working set.

passes.name: static.diffuse
passes.summary: Planned diffuse*vertex colour plus optional fog; no plan emitted yet.

pipelines.accepted_original: Planned paired VS/PS contract: ps_3_0, four-bone skinning in the vertex stage, <=3 texture samples in the selected PS pass, no branching in PS. The full 2,162-chunk family is not accepted by this descriptor.
pipelines.package_rule: 18 character-classified packages plus shaders001 membrane/facegen programs; pair by engine package/meta, not by guessing from PS alone.
pipelines.vertex_inputs: Position, normal, tangent/binormal as needed, blendweight, blendindices, texcoord0 and colour0; bone matrices from the 96-register VS uniform budget.
pipelines.texture_units: Diffuse, normal and one detail/mask texture; 16 tint colours are constants, not 16 textures.
pipelines.quality_reductions: Four bones maximum, one directional light, constant tint palette, no subsurface/point-light/envmap detail, hardware alpha test, LDR output.
pipelines.unsupported: More than four influences, morph targets, dynamic branching, >3 PS textures, HDR skin, facial detail passes beyond the three-unit budget.
pipelines.fallback: Reject unsupported character materials; a frozen diffuse pose is a separate explicit debug mode, not an automatic pipeline fallback.
pipelines.memory: Per-draw matrix palette and light uniforms must fit 96 VS float registers alongside varyings/fog; three resident textures at most. Retain animation buffers and skin/clothing texture streams, not the original SM3 stream after planning.

passes.name: character.skin
passes.vertex_inputs: position, normal, blendweight, blendindices, texcoord0, color0
passes.summary: Vertex skinning plus specialised 2-4 stage PS; plan not implemented.

passes.name: character.detail
passes.summary: Optional second pass only when one PS pass cannot hold the requested detail.

pipelines.inventory_signature: No grass/tree bytecode family. Material/mesh metadata selects lighting/059-style alpha-tested, vertex-coloured foliage.
pipelines.accepted_original: Planned material contract only: caller supplies diffuse, optional normal, vertex colour, wind parameters and alpha-test reference. Do not infer foliage from CTAB names or hashes.
pipelines.package_rule: Mesh/material metadata; the classifier reports zero grass/trees chunks.
pipelines.vertex_inputs: Position, normal, texcoord0, color0; optional instance/wind parameters supplied by the vertex stage.
pipelines.texture_units: Unit 0: diffuse/alpha foliage texture. Unit 1: optional predecoded normal.
pipelines.quality_reductions: No normal map, no shadows, no specular, two-level wind approximation, hardware alpha test and LDR vertex colour.
pipelines.unsupported: Alpha-blended foliage needing per-pixel depth sorting, dense grass without culling/instancing, HDR and more than two texture units.
pipelines.fallback: Cull the batch or reject it; no opaque world-material substitution.
pipelines.memory: One or two foliage textures per batch, small wind uniforms and caller-owned instance/vertex buffer. Sort/cull on CPU before drawing to bound texture swaps.

passes.name: vegetation
passes.summary: Texture*vertex colour plus optional cheap normal lighting; plan not implemented.

pipelines.inventory_signature: WaterParams/ReflectionColor/ShallowColor/DeepColor/Normals01..03Sampler/RefractionSampler/CubeMapSampler/DisplaceMap and related CTAB names; 4-7 samples, 24 loop/branch chunks.
pipelines.accepted_original: Planned specialised contract: ps_3_0 water vocabulary, caller-provided reflection/refraction targets and <=3 surface textures per pass. Whole-program translation is explicitly not accepted.
pipelines.package_rule: Water-classified chunks in shaders001; reflection/refraction target state is part of acceptance.
pipelines.vertex_inputs: Position, normal, texcoord0, world/view position and optional displacement parameters.
pipelines.texture_units: Original: 1-3 normal layers, reflection, refraction and optional cube/displacement/height maps. PICA: reflection + refraction + one packed normal layer per surface pass.
pipelines.quality_reductions: One normal layer, no displacement, static or lower-resolution reflection, simplified Fresnel, opaque depth prepass; retain refraction colour blend.
pipelines.unsupported: Dynamic loops, >3 surface textures, HDR water, cube sampling without a prefiltered 2D lookup, per-pixel reflection scene rendering in the same pass.
pipelines.fallback: Explicit opaque tinted depth-only surface or reject the water draw; never silently show the sky through missing targets.
pipelines.memory: Reflection and refraction colour targets plus a depth target at the chosen render resolution (2*W*H*4 + depth bytes), three surface textures and saved scene state. Target residency, not shader bytecode, dominates water working set.

passes.name: water.reflection
passes.summary: Render the mirrored scene first; optional clip plane/cull policy belongs to the backend.

passes.name: water.refraction
passes.summary: Render the scene behind the surface before the water pass.

passes.name: water.surface
passes.summary: Normal distortion, Fresnel blend and depth tint; plan not implemented.

pipelines.inventory_signature: Engine-fixed BSEffectShaderProperty billboard: position/centre, texcoord0, colour0 and size; texture(s) plus alpha/additive blend.
pipelines.accepted_original: No .fxp ships for BSEffectShaderProperty, including the measured menu fog mesh. Planned contract is texture*vertex colour with alpha or additive blending, not SM3 translation.
pipelines.package_rule: Effect material metadata; menu fog uses FXSteamThinAnim.dds and GradSteamThin.dds.
pipelines.vertex_inputs: Centre/size or camera-facing quad position, texcoord0, colour0, rotation and optional animation parameters.
pipelines.texture_units: Unit 0: effect texture; optional unit 1 for a mask/gradient in a second pass.
pipelines.quality_reductions: One texture, vertex colour, no per-particle lighting, no soft depth, point/quad billboards, alpha or additive blend.
pipelines.unsupported: Six/seven-sample effect shaders in one pass, non-uniform .zwz sprite swizzles, mesh particles requiring independent transforms, HDR and depth-sorted alpha without CPU sorting.
pipelines.fallback: Reject or omit the effect batch. Do not translate the 136 seven-sample PS chunks through a one-texture template.
pipelines.memory: One or two resident textures plus a packed dynamic quad buffer; CPU sort/instance buffers scale with live particle count. Original effect streams are not retained after a fixed plan is selected.

passes.name: particle.billboard
passes.summary: Texture*vertex colour with optional second mask pass; plan not implemented.

pipelines.inventory_signature: FlareColor/FlareHDR/BloodColor/SparkleSampler or colour+texcoord billboard VS; 172 PS with 6-7 samples in 160 chunks.
pipelines.accepted_original: Planned acceptance is limited to specialised straight-line effect signatures after explicit swizzle baking; the six generic-translator accepts remain cross-family unlit utility matches, not a complete effect implementation.
pipelines.package_rule: Three effect-classified packages plus utility chunks in shaders001; caller must route effect intent explicitly.
pipelines.vertex_inputs: Billboard position/centre, texcoord0, colour0, psize or quad corner; optional rotation.
pipelines.texture_units: Original effect programs use up to seven samples. PICA fixed path uses one or two units; faithful multi-pass path needs at least three passes.
pipelines.quality_reductions: Bake .zwz sprite swizzles offline, collapse flare/blood/sparkle terms to texture*vertex colour, use additive/alpha blend, drop HDR.
pipelines.unsupported: Single-pass seven-sample shaders, non-uniform swizzles, rcp/texkill, MRT, HDR and unsorted alpha.
pipelines.fallback: particles.billboard after explicit effect-material conversion; otherwise reject with the named opcode/swizzle reason.
pipelines.memory: Faithful path needs at least three texture-binding groups; fixed path needs one or two textures and one dynamic vertex batch. Do not keep all seven original textures resident.

passes.name: particle.fxp
passes.summary: At least three passes for seven-sample retail effects, or explicit conversion to particles.billboard; no plan emitted yet.
